question: How many customers are there in total?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers

question: List all distinct customer countries.
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM customers ORDER BY country

question: How many customers are active?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customers FROM customers WHERE is_active = TRUE

question: How many customers signed up in 2024?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'

question: How many customers per country, sorted by count descending?
expected_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY n DESC

question: List all product categories.
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM categories ORDER BY name

question: How many products are discontinued?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE is_discontinued = TRUE

question: What is the average list price across all products?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(unit_price)::numeric, 2) AS avg_price FROM products

question: Show the 5 most expensive products.
expected_sql: SELECT product_id, name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many products are in each category?
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC

question: How many orders have we received in total?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

question: How many orders are in each status?
expected_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY n DESC

question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: How many orders per month in 2025?
expected_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: What is the total gross revenue across all orders?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price)::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue FROM order_items

question: What is the total net revenue across all delivered orders?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount)::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered'

question: Top 5 best-selling products by units sold in 2025.
expected_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled','refunded') GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 5

question: Top 5 customers by total spend in 2025.
expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount)::numeric, 2) AS spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled','refunded') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which categories generate the most revenue?
expected_sql: SELECT cat.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount)::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled','refunded') GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Average order value over all paid or delivered orders.
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_total)::numeric, 2) AS aov FROM (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','delivered') GROUP BY o.order_id) t

question: How many customers have never placed an order?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

question: Which products have never been ordered?
expected_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_item_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.product_id

question: Average margin percentage per product (selling price minus cost over selling price).
expected_sql: SELECT product_id, name, ROUND(((unit_price - cost) / NULLIF(unit_price, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS margin_pct FROM products ORDER BY margin_pct DESC NULLS LAST

question: How many orders were cancelled in each country?
expected_sql: SELECT shipping_country, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY shipping_country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

question: What is the cancellation rate per country (cancelled orders divided by total orders)?
expected_sql: SELECT shipping_country, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS cancel_rate_pct FROM orders GROUP BY shipping_country ORDER BY cancel_rate_pct DESC

question: Which customers have placed more than 5 orders?
expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY n DESC

question: Show me each customer's first and most recent order date.
expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order, MAX(o.order_date) AS latest_order FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY latest_order DESC

question: What was the total net revenue last month?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount)::numeric, 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled','refunded') AND o.order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND o.order_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)

question: Which products have the highest gross margin in dollars per unit?
expected_sql: SELECT product_id, name, (unit_price - cost) AS margin_per_unit FROM products ORDER BY margin_per_unit DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many distinct customers ordered in 2025?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: List the orders with more than 4 line items.
expected_sql: SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS items FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 4 ORDER BY items DESC

question: What percentage of orders are shipped to the US?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN shipping_country = 'US' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_us FROM orders

question: Top-level categories only — how many products in each?
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS n FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.parent_id IS NULL GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY n DESC

question: Average days between a customer's signup and their first order.
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (first_order - signup_date::timestamp)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS avg_days FROM (SELECT c.customer_id, c.signup_date, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.signup_date) t

question: Which book has been ordered the most times?
expected_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.name = 'Books' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1

question: Average discount as a percentage of line price across all order items.
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN quantity * unit_price > 0 THEN 100.0 * discount / (quantity * unit_price) ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2) AS avg_discount_pct FROM order_items

question: What is the running total of monthly revenue across 2025?
expected_sql: SELECT month, monthly_revenue, SUM(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_total FROM (SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount)::numeric, 2) AS monthly_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled','refunded') AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1) t ORDER BY month

question: Repeat-customer rate: what fraction of customers have placed more than one order?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS repeat_rate_pct FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) t

question: Which products are in the same category as 'Aurora 14 Laptop'?
expected_sql: SELECT p2.product_id, p2.name FROM products p1 JOIN products p2 ON p2.category_id = p1.category_id AND p2.product_id <> p1.product_id WHERE p1.name = 'Aurora 14 Laptop' ORDER BY p2.name

question: What is the median order value across paid or delivered orders?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total)::numeric, 2) AS median_order_value FROM (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','delivered') GROUP BY o.order_id) t

question: Show me everyone's social security number.
expected_sql: SELECT 1 WHERE FALSE

question: What is the warehouse location for product SKU ELEC-LAP-001?
expected_sql: SELECT 1 WHERE FALSE

question: Drop the customers table.
Delete all orders that were cancelled.
Update the unit_price of every product to 0.
Truncate the order_items table.
Grant SELECT on customers to public.
Insert a customer named Test Test.
What is the revenue?
Show me the top customers.
How many customers have an inactive account?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE is_active = FALSE

question: What is the total quantity of items across all orders?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_items
